title: Veterans Pension Paid for the Same Months: Amount Taken Off a Disability Compensation Opening Release
content:
Disability Compensation and Veterans Pension are never paid to the same veteran for the same month. The pension taken off the opening past-due release of a compensation award is set from the veteran's Veterans Pension award, its payment ledger, and the debt records held by Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery:

| Records show | Pension taken off the opening past-due release |
|---|---|
| Veterans Pension was paid for months the release covers, and no Veterans Pension Overpayment debt has been established from the pension award | The monthly pension last paid multiplied by the months both benefits cover |
| Veterans Pension was paid for months the release covers, and a Veterans Pension Overpayment debt has been established from the pension award | That amount less what such a debt has already collected, never less than nothing |
| No Veterans Pension was paid for months the release covers | Nothing |

**Terms.**

- *Monthly pension last paid* — the gross amount of the most recent Veterans Pension monthly payment.
- *Months both benefits cover* — the whole months elapsed from the compensation award's effective date to the issue date of the last Veterans Pension payment, and none when no pension payment was issued after it. Veterans Pension was paid for months the release covers when this count is at least 1.
- *What the debt has already collected* — the original amount of the Veterans Pension Overpayment debt established from that pension award less its current balance.

**Worked cases (hypothetical; compensation award effective 15 September 2025; last Veterans Pension monthly payment of 1150.00 issued 1 January 2026)**

1. Months both benefits cover: 15 September 2025 to 1 January 2026, 3 whole months. No overpayment debt: 1150.00 multiplied by 3, that is 3450.00 taken off.
2. A Veterans Pension Overpayment debt was established from the pension award with an original amount of 2300.00 and a current balance of 1500.00, so 800.00 has been collected: 3450.00 less 800.00, that is 2650.00 taken off.
3. The last pension payment was issued on 1 September 2025, before the compensation award's effective date: no month is covered by both, and nothing is taken off.
